Injection PP Cups — 90 / 92 / 95 mm Hard-Wall Plastic Cups

Hard injection-molded PP cups with a premium in-hand feel for milk tea chains, fresh juice bars and yogurt brands. Available in round and square shapes, clear and frosted finishes, compatible with both hot and cold drinks and with standard cup sealing machines.

  • Calibers 90 / 92 (square) / 95 mm
  • Capacities 360 ml to 960 ml
  • Clear and frosted finishes
  • Round U-shape and square formats
  • Hot & cold compatible, sealing-machine ready
  • Custom injection molds for exclusive shapes
  • FDA & CE food-contact compliance

Why Choose Injection PP Over Thermoformed Cups

Injection molding produces a thicker, rigid wall that feels closer to reusable drinkware — the tactile quality premium tea and coffee brands want. Unlike thin thermoformed cups, our injection PP cups hold shape when filled with hot drinks and resist cracking during transport. We offer round U-shape and modern square profiles, in high-clarity and frosted finishes, plus custom mold development for brands that need an exclusive shape.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between PET and PP cups?

PET offers glass-like clarity but is cold-only. PP is slightly less clear, withstands hot drinks up to 100°C, feels sturdier and is available frosted. Most tea chains use PP for hot/premium drinks and PET for standard iced drinks.

Do you offer square injection cups?

Yes. Our 92mm square series runs 500ml, 650ml and 960ml in both clear and frosted finishes — a distinctive on-shelf look versus round cups.

Can you develop a custom cup shape?

Yes. We support custom injection molds for exclusive shapes and embossed logos. Mold lead time is typically 25-35 days; contact us with your design.

Do PP cups work with sealing machines?

Yes, our 90/95mm round PP cups are designed for standard sealing machines with PP sealing film.
